items.defEn: lacking initiative or effectiveness; irresponsible
items.usage: 強烈貶義，指責人既無效率又無擔當。
items.exampleEn: Feckless oversight allowed the same error to recur across three audits.
items.exampleZh: 不負責任的督導使同一錯誤在三次稽核中反覆出現。

items.defEn: intellectually or physically productive; fertile
items.usage: 可指土地、想像力或學術產出。
items.exampleEn: That decade was a fecund period for comparative legal scholarship.
items.exampleZh: 那個十年是比較法學研究的多產時期。

items.defEn: pretend; give a false appearance of
items.usage: 常見 feign surprise / ignorance / illness。
items.exampleEn: Several respondents may have feigned agreement to end the interview faster.
items.exampleZh: 若干受訪者可能假裝同意，只為更快結束訪談。

items.defEn: well chosen or suited to the circumstances; pleasingly apt
items.usage: 多讚用語、時機或表達：a felicitous phrase。
items.exampleEn: The translator’s felicitous rendering preserved the joke without a footnote.
items.exampleZh: 譯者恰當的處理保留了笑話，無需加註。

items.defEn: wild and untamed, especially after escape from domestication
items.usage: 可指動物，亦可比喻舉止失控。
items.exampleEn: Feral cats on the grounds complicated the bird-count protocol.
items.exampleZh: 場地裡的野貓使鳥類計數規程變得複雜。

items.defEn: showing intense, sincere feeling
items.usage: 可褒（熱忱）亦可暗示過度激烈。
items.exampleEn: Fervent advocates of the ban underestimated enforcement costs.
items.exampleZh: 該禁令的熱烈支持者低估了執法成本。

items.defEn: intensely passionate, sometimes to excess
items.usage: 比 fervent 更易帶「過熱、失控」的暗示。
items.exampleEn: Fervid editorials on both sides left little room for compromise language.
items.exampleZh: 兩邊極度熱烈的社論幾乎不留妥協措辭的空間。

items.defEn: intense and passionate feeling
items.usage: 宗教、政治與學術論戰皆常見。
items.exampleEn: The reform was passed in a fervor that faded before implementation.
items.exampleZh: 改革在一股熱忱中通過，卻在實施前便消退。

items.defEn: changing frequently, especially in loyalty or affection
items.usage: 可形容人、輿論、市場或天氣。
items.exampleEn: Fickle donor interest made multiyear staffing nearly impossible.
items.exampleZh: 善變的捐助意願使多年期人事幾乎無法規劃。

items.defEn: faithfulness to a person, cause, or original
items.usage: 可指人際忠誠，亦可指錄音、翻譯對原文的忠實。
items.exampleEn: The new edition prizes fidelity to the manuscript over readable punctuation.
items.exampleZh: 新版重視對手稿的忠實，勝過易讀的標點。

items.defEn: lose energy or interest; grow weak
items.usage: GRE 考動詞「衰退」，不是旗幟名詞；常見 energy flags。
items.exampleEn: Public attention flagged long before the commission issued its findings.
items.exampleZh: 公眾注意力早在委員會發布調查結果之前就已減退。

items.defEn: conspicuously offensive; glaringly wrong
items.usage: 強調錯誤明顯到無法忽視：flagrant violation。
items.exampleEn: The hiring was a flagrant breach of the conflict-of-interest policy.
items.exampleZh: 這次聘用公然違反利益衝突政策。

items.defEn: showy, colorful, and intended to attract attention
items.usage: 可褒（有風格）可貶（過於張揚）。
items.exampleEn: A flamboyant keynote can overshadow the quieter empirical papers.
items.exampleZh: 華麗招搖的主題演講可能掩蓋較低調的實證論文。

items.defEn: young, inexperienced, or newly formed
items.usage: 可作名詞「新手」；常修飾 company, democracy, researcher。
items.exampleEn: The fledgling journal still lacked a stable pool of reviewers.
items.exampleZh: 這本剛起步的期刊仍缺乏穩定的審稿人庫。

items.defEn: not showing proper seriousness or respect
items.usage: 負面，指責態度輕慢，尤其在嚴肅場合。
items.exampleEn: A flippant answer about fatalities angered the families in the gallery.
items.exampleZh: 對死亡人數輕佻的回答激怒了旁聽席上的家屬。

items.defEn: openly disregard a rule or convention
items.usage: GRE 勿與 flaunt（炫耀）混淆。
items.exampleEn: Vendors who flout sanitation rules will lose their permits.
items.exampleZh: 公然違抗衛生規定的攤商將失去許可。

items.defEn: an unlikely chance occurrence, especially a lucky one
items.usage: 口語色彩較重，學術上暗示結果可能不可複製。
items.exampleEn: The first successful trial looked like a fluke until two labs replicated it.
items.exampleZh: 第一次成功試驗看似僥倖，直到兩間實驗室複現了結果。

items.defEn: a minor weakness or eccentricity of character
items.usage: 語氣寬容，指無傷大雅的弱點，不是嚴重惡行。
items.exampleEn: Late-night emailing was a foible colleagues learned to work around.
items.exampleZh: 深夜寄信是同事們學會遷就的小毛病。

items.defEn: stir up trouble, unrest, or strong feeling
items.usage: 受詞多為 unrest, rebellion, discord；負面為主。
items.exampleEn: Anonymous posts fomented distrust between the two research units.
items.exampleZh: 匿名貼文煽動了兩個研究單位之間的不信任。

items.defEn: refrain from doing something; be patient
items.usage: 正式語；名詞 forbearance 在金融與法律中亦常見。
items.exampleEn: The chair asked members to forbear personal attacks during debate.
items.exampleZh: 主席要求成員在辯論中克制人身攻擊。

items.defEn: prevent or obstruct by taking action ahead of time
items.usage: 強調「搶先一步以免壞事發生」。
items.exampleEn: Early disclosure forestalled rumors that the lab had hidden negative results.
items.exampleZh: 及早揭露預先阻止了實驗室隱瞞負面結果的謠言。

items.defEn: inspiring fear or respect through being powerful or difficult
items.defZh: 令人敬畏的；難以應付的
items.usage: 可指對手、障礙、才幹或任務規模。
items.exampleEn: The committee faced a formidable backlog of unreviewed applications.
items.exampleZh: 委員會面對難以應付的未審申請積壓。

items.defEn: happening by chance, often with a favorable result
items.usage: GRE 可指單純「偶然」，語境常帶幸運色彩。
items.exampleEn: A fortuitous overlap in travel schedules made the joint interview possible.
items.exampleZh: 行程偶然重疊，使聯合訪談成為可能。

items.defEn: encourage the development of
items.usage: 政策與教育高頻：foster innovation / dialogue。
items.exampleEn: Weekly writing groups foster clearer prose among graduate students.
items.exampleZh: 每週寫作小組培養研究生更清晰的文筆。

items.defEn: fail completely; fill with water and sink
items.usage: GRE 考動詞「失敗／沉沒」，不是「創辦人」名詞。
items.exampleEn: The merger foundered when neither side would cede data control.
items.exampleZh: 雙方都不願交出資料控制權，合併因而失敗。

items.defEn: irritable and quarrelsome; hard to control
items.defZh: 易怒好爭的；難以駕馭的
items.usage: 可形容兒童、派系、委員會或動物。
items.exampleEn: A fractious coalition delayed the budget until after the fiscal deadline.
items.exampleZh: 一個好爭的聯盟把預算拖過了會計期限。

items.defEn: filled with something undesirable; tense
items.defZh: 充滿（負面事物）的；緊張的
items.usage: 常見 fraught with danger / tension；現代英語亦可單用表「劍拔弩張」。
items.exampleEn: Negotiations were fraught with mistrust after the leaked memo.
items.exampleZh: 備忘錄外洩後，談判充滿不信任。

items.defEn: fast and energetic in a wild, uncontrolled way
items.usage: 帶失控感，比 busy 更強調慌亂。
items.exampleEn: Frenetic last-minute editing introduced errors the proof had already fixed.
items.exampleZh: 狂亂的最後修訂又引入了校樣已修正的錯誤。

items.defEn: sparing with resources; economical
items.usage: 多為褒義；frugal with 可接 money, time, words。
items.exampleEn: A frugal design reused existing sensors instead of buying new hardware.
items.exampleZh: 節儉的設計重用既有感測器，而非購買新硬體。

items.defEn: protest or denounce loudly and bitterly
items.usage: 正式語，常接 against；帶爆炸般猛烈的語氣。
items.exampleEn: Columnists fulminated against the secrecy surrounding the appointments.
items.exampleZh: 專欄作家怒斥任命過程的祕密作風。

items.defEn: excessively flattering, often to the point of insincerity
items.defZh: 過分恭維的；虛偽溢美的
items.usage: GRE 多考負面「過譽」，不是單純「豐富充足」。
items.exampleEn: Fulsome praise in the blurb made serious readers suspicious.
items.exampleZh: 封面簡介裡過分的讚詞讓嚴謹讀者起疑。

items.defEn: attempting to avoid notice; secretive
items.defZh: 鬼鬼祟祟的；偷偷摸摸的
items.usage: 強調動作隱蔽，常暗示心虛。
items.exampleEn: A furtive transfer of files triggered the security alert.
items.exampleZh: 一次偷偷摸摸的檔案轉移觸發了安全警報。

items.defEn: incapable of producing any useful result
items.usage: 常見 a futile attempt / it is futile to。
items.exampleEn: Without baseline data, further comparison would be futile.
items.exampleZh: 沒有基線資料，再比較也是徒勞。

items.defEn: an embarrassing social or diplomatic blunder
items.usage: 社交與政治新聞常用；程度可輕可重。
items.exampleEn: Mispronouncing the donor’s name was a gaffe the host regretted at once.
items.exampleZh: 把捐助者姓名念錯，是主持人立刻後悔的失禮。

items.defEn: deny or contradict
items.usage: 正式且略古；常見 there is no gainsaying。
items.exampleEn: No one could gainsay the drop in infection rates after the campaign.
items.exampleZh: 無人能否認行動後感染率的下降。

items.defEn: shock or excite into taking action
items.usage: 政策與社會運動高頻：galvanize support / voters。
items.exampleEn: The leaked memo galvanized staff who had stayed silent for months.
items.exampleZh: 外洩的備忘錄激勵了沉默數月的員工採取行動。

items.defEn: obtrusively bright and showy
items.usage: 負面美學評價，指顏色或裝飾過分搶眼。
items.exampleEn: Garish cover art made a careful study look like a supermarket flyer.
items.exampleZh: 俗麗刺眼的封面使嚴謹研究看起來像超市傳單。

items.defEn: excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters
items.usage: 貶義，強調話多而內容瑣碎。
items.exampleEn: A garrulous witness buried the key fact under twenty minutes of asides.
items.exampleZh: 一位喋喋不休的證人把關鍵事實埋在二十分鐘的題外話裡。

items.defEn: extravagantly bright or showy in a tasteless way
items.usage: 與 garish 近義，皆指責品味廉價張揚。
items.exampleEn: Gaudy charts with 3D effects hid how thin the evidence was.
items.exampleZh: 花俏的立體圖表掩蓋了證據何其薄弱。

items.defEn: relevant to the matter at hand
items.usage: 會議與寫作常用 germane to the issue。
items.exampleEn: Only questions germane to the sampling method were allowed.
items.exampleZh: 只允許與抽樣方法切題的問題。

items.defEn: fluent and easy, but shallow or insincere
items.defZh: 油嘴滑舌的；流利卻膚淺的
items.usage: 負面，指責回答太順、缺真誠或深度。
items.exampleEn: A glib assurance that “the model is robust” did not survive peer review.
items.exampleZh: 「模型很穩健」這句油滑保證沒能撐過同儕審查。

items.defEn: an excessive supply
items.usage: 經濟與出版常見 a glut of；亦可作動詞「使充斥」。
items.exampleEn: A glut of similar papers made it harder for original work to be noticed.
items.exampleZh: 大量雷同論文使原創研究更難被看見。

items.defEn: provoke or annoy so as to stimulate action
items.usage: 可中性「鞭策」，亦可負面「挑激」。
items.exampleEn: Sharply worded referee reports goaded the authors into a clearer revision.
items.exampleZh: 措辭犀利的審稿意見驅使作者做出更清楚的修訂。

items.defEn: overcharge; cut or scoop out
items.usage: GRE 常考「漫天要價」；price-gouging 為搭配。
items.exampleEn: Hotels were fined for gouging stranded passengers during the shutdown.
items.exampleZh: 旅館因在停運期間向受困旅客敲竹槓而被罰款。

items.defEn: pompous or extravagant in language
items.defZh: 誇張華麗的；言過其實的
items.usage: 專門批評文體或演說的虛華。
items.exampleEn: Grandiloquent claims of a “historic breakthrough” outran the actual data.
items.exampleZh: 「歷史性突破」的誇張宣稱超越了實際數據。

items.defEn: impressive in appearance but overly ambitious or pretentious
items.defZh: 浮誇的；不切實際地宏大的
items.usage: 負面多於正面，暗示規模或自我評價過大。
items.exampleEn: A grandiose reconstruction plan ignored the city’s actual tax base.
items.exampleZh: 一個浮誇的重建計畫忽略了城市實際的稅基。

items.defEn: uncalled for; given without good reason
items.usage: GRE 多考「多餘、沒來由」，不一定是「免費」。
items.exampleEn: The report’s gratuitous attacks on junior staff weakened its credible findings.
items.exampleZh: 報告對初級人員的無端攻擊削弱了其可信發現。

items.defEn: fond of company; sociable
items.usage: 可指人，亦可指群居動物。
items.exampleEn: A gregarious field director built trust faster than any printed protocol could.
items.exampleZh: 一位合群的田野主任建立信任的速度，比任何紙本規程都快。

items.defEn: act in an excessively submissive manner
items.usage: 強烈貶義；可字面匍匐，亦可比喻搖尾乞憐。
items.exampleEn: No editor should grovel for advertising at the cost of independent review.
items.exampleZh: 編輯不該為廣告而卑躬屈膝，犧牲獨立審查。

items.defEn: sly or cunning intelligence used to deceive
items.usage: 正式語；be without guile 指毫無詭詐。
items.exampleEn: The negotiation failed because guile replaced any attempt at candor.
items.exampleZh: 談判失敗，因為狡詐取代了任何坦誠的嘗試。

items.defEn: innocent and without deception
items.defZh: 天真無邪的；毫無詭詐的
items.usage: 多為褒義，讚賞真誠；有時也暗示易受騙。
items.exampleEn: Her guileless account of the meeting matched the recording exactly.
items.exampleZh: 她對會議毫無詭詐的陳述與錄音完全吻合。

items.defEn: easily persuaded to believe something
items.usage: 貶義；名詞 gullibility。
items.exampleEn: A gullible intern forwarded a fake invoice that looked official.
items.exampleZh: 一位輕信的實習生轉發了看似正式的假發票。

items.defEn: overused and therefore lacking originality
items.usage: 寫作評價高頻，指責比喻或論點用濫。
items.exampleEn: The conclusion relies on hackneyed phrases about “thinking outside the box.”
items.exampleZh: 結論倚賴「跳出框框思考」這類陳腔濫調。

items.defEn: honor as holy; treat as sacred
items.usage: 宗教與修辭皆見；past participle hallowed 更常見。
items.exampleEn: The community voted to hallow the burial ground and forbid commercial use.
items.exampleZh: 社群表決尊該墓地為聖地，並禁止商業使用。

items.defEn: hinder or impede the movement or progress of
items.usage: GRE 常考「hamper progress / development」。
items.exampleEn: Poor lighting hampered the team's ability to document the site.
items.exampleZh: 光線不足妨礙了團隊紀錄現場。

items.defEn: a lengthy, scolding public speech; to lecture aggressively at length
items.defZh: 長篇苛責演說；慷慨激昂地訓斥
items.usage: GRE 常把 harangue 當「冗長且帶攻擊性的演說」。
items.exampleEn: The senator harangued the committee for an hour about budget waste.
items.exampleZh: 那位參議員對委員會長篇訓斥預算浪費，講了整整一小時。

items.defEn: a person or event that signals what is coming
items.usage: 常與 of 連用，表「某事即將發生的前兆」。
items.exampleEn: A sudden drop in orders was a harbinger of the coming recession.
items.exampleZh: 訂單驟降是即將到來的經濟衰退之先兆。

items.defEn: robust enough to endure difficult conditions
items.usage: 可用於人或植物，強調能熬過嚴酷環境。
items.exampleEn: Only hardy seedlings survived the unheated greenhouse through January.
items.exampleZh: 只有強健的幼苗撐過一月未加熱的溫室。

items.defEn: openly proud and contemptuous of others
items.usage: 語氣比 proud 更負面，帶輕蔑。
items.exampleEn: Her haughty refusal to answer junior staff made collaboration almost impossible.
items.exampleZh: 她傲慢地拒絕回應基層同事，使合作幾乎無法進行。

items.defEn: the pursuit of pleasure as the chief good
items.usage: GRE 常對比 asceticism（禁慾）與 hedonism。
items.exampleEn: Critics accused the resort culture of promoting hedonism over civic duty.
items.exampleZh: 批評者指控度假村文化把享樂置於公民責任之上。

items.defEn: dominant influence of one group over others
items.usage: 常考政治、文化上的「支配權」，搭配 cultural / political。
items.exampleEn: The empire maintained regional hegemony through trade and naval power.
items.exampleZh: 該帝國藉貿易與海軍力量維持區域霸權。

items.defEn: belief that departs from accepted doctrine
items.usage: 不必限於宗教，學術界也可稱挑戰主流的主張為 heresy。
items.exampleEn: Questioning the model was treated as heresy in that research group.
items.exampleZh: 在那個研究團隊裡，質疑該模型被當成異端。

items.defEn: sealed so tightly as to be isolated from outside influence
items.usage: GRE 多考比喻義「封閉、外人難入」。
items.exampleEn: The lab operated in a hermetic circle of specialists who rarely published drafts.
items.exampleZh: 該實驗室在封閉的專家圈中運作，很少公開草稿。

items.defEn: composed of unlike or diverse elements
items.usage: 與 homogeneous 成對出現，記「hetero- = 異」。
items.exampleEn: The sample was too heterogeneous for a single statistical model to fit well.
items.exampleZh: 樣本過於異質，單一統計模型難以擬合。

items.defEn: a pause or gap in a sequence of activity
items.usage: 常指計畫、職涯或出版上的暫停。
items.exampleEn: After a two-year hiatus, the journal resumed quarterly publication.
items.exampleZh: 停刊兩年後，該期刊恢復季刊發行。

items.defEn: a ranked system of levels or authority
items.usage: GRE 常考 social / organizational hierarchy。
items.exampleEn: Promotion in the firm still followed a rigid hierarchy of seniority.
items.exampleZh: 該公司升遷仍依僵化的年資層級。

items.defEn: something that delays or obstructs progress
items.usage: 是 hamper / hinder 的名詞，常作「a hindrance to」。
items.exampleEn: Incomplete records proved a serious hindrance to the audit.
items.exampleZh: 紀錄不全對稽核構成嚴重障礙。

items.defEn: public respect or tribute paid to someone
items.usage: 固定搭配 pay homage to。
items.exampleEn: The exhibition paid homage to the architects who rebuilt the district.
items.exampleZh: 展覽向重建該區的建築師致敬。

items.defEn: uniform in composition or character
items.usage: 與 heterogeneous 相對；homo- = 同。
items.exampleEn: The committee was too homogeneous to represent the city's range of views.
items.exampleZh: 委員會過於同質，無法代表城市的多元觀點。

items.defEn: to sharpen or refine a skill through practice
items.usage: GRE 常考 hone skills / instincts，不一定指磨刀。
items.exampleEn: She honed her arguments through weekly debates with faculty.
items.exampleZh: 她藉每週與教師辯論來磨練論點。

items.defEn: to use sparingly and conserve for later need
items.usage: GRE 考動詞義「撙節資源」，不是「丈夫」。
items.exampleEn: The expedition husbanded its water supply during the desert crossing.
items.exampleZh: 探險隊在穿越沙漠時撙節用水。

items.defEn: deliberate exaggeration for emphasis or effect
items.usage: 修辭格；答題時勿當成「謊言」本身。
items.exampleEn: Calling the draft a masterpiece was hyperbole, not a measured review.
items.exampleZh: 稱那份草稿為傑作是誇飾，不是審慎評論。

items.defEn: pretending to hold virtues or beliefs one does not practice
items.usage: 強調「言行不一」，常批評公眾人物。
items.exampleEn: It seemed hypocritical to demand austerity while expanding executive perks.
items.exampleZh: 一邊要求緊縮、一邊擴大高階福利，顯得偽善。

items.defEn: one who attacks cherished beliefs or institutions
items.defZh: 偶像破壞者；挑戰傳統之人
items.usage: GRE 多為中性或褒義的「破除迷信者」。
items.exampleEn: The iconoclast economist rejected models that the field still treated as sacred.
items.exampleZh: 那位破除偶像的經濟學家拒絕學界仍奉為圭臬的模型。

items.defEn: a system of ideas that guides political or social action
items.usage: 常帶「整套信念」，不一定等於單一意見。
items.exampleEn: Housing policy in the city was shaped more by ideology than by data.
items.exampleZh: 該市住房政策受意識形態影響多於數據。

items.defEn: a distinctive personal habit or peculiar trait
items.usage: 可指人的怪癖，也可指系統的特殊之處。
items.exampleEn: One idiosyncrasy of the software was that it saved drafts only on exit.
items.exampleZh: 該軟體有個怪癖：只在退出時儲存草稿。

items.defEn: excessive devotion to a person, idea, or object
items.usage: 比喻義「過度崇拜」比宗教義更常考。
items.exampleEn: The board warned against idolatry of quarterly metrics at the expense of research.
items.exampleZh: 董事會警告勿盲目崇拜季度指標而犧牲研究。

items.defEn: peacefully charming, as if in an idealized rural scene
items.defZh: 田園詩般的；恬靜美好的
items.usage: 常帶「過於美好、近乎理想化」的色彩。
items.exampleEn: The report contrasted the idyllic brochure photos with actual living conditions.
items.exampleZh: 報告把宣傳冊上田園詩般的照片與實際居住條件對照。

items.defEn: base in character; lacking honor
items.usage: 與 noble 相對，評人品或動機。
items.exampleEn: Diverting relief funds for private travel was an ignoble misuse of office.
items.exampleZh: 把救濟金挪作私人旅行，是不光彩的濫權。

items.defEn: bringing public shame or disgrace
items.usage: 常修飾失敗、撤退、下場。
items.exampleEn: The campaign ended in an ignominious withdrawal from the primary.
items.exampleZh: 該競選以丟臉地退出初選告終。

items.defEn: not permitted by law or custom
items.usage: 比 illegal 更廣，也可指違規、不正當。
items.exampleEn: The inquiry traced illicit transfers through a chain of shell companies.
items.exampleZh: 調查循空殼公司鏈追查非法轉帳。

items.defEn: widely known for notable achievement
items.usage: 多用於正面的名聲與成就。
items.exampleEn: She joined an illustrious line of researchers who had held the same chair.
items.exampleZh: 她加入了一連串曾任同一教席的傑出研究者。

items.defEn: to drink in; to absorb ideas or atmosphere
items.usage: GRE 常考比喻義「吸收觀念」，不只是喝酒。
items.exampleEn: Graduate students imbibed the department's caution toward grand theory.
items.exampleZh: 研究生吸收了該系對宏大理論的審慎態度。

items.defEn: to fill or saturate with a quality or feeling
items.usage: 搭配 imbue with，受詞常是精神、色彩、信念。
items.exampleEn: The curator imbued the exhibition with a quiet sense of mourning.
items.exampleZh: 策展人使展覽充滿沉靜的哀悼感。

items.defEn: about to occur, usually with a sense of urgency
items.defZh: 即將發生的；迫在眉睫的
items.usage: 易與 immanent（內在的）混淆，GRE 愛考。
items.exampleEn: With flooding imminent, the archive moved fragile manuscripts upstairs.
items.exampleZh: 洪水迫在眉睫，檔案館把脆弱手稿搬到樓上。

items.defEn: not subject to change
items.usage: 常修飾法則、原則、條件。
items.exampleEn: The charter treated those voting rules as immutable, even in a crisis.
items.exampleZh: 章程把那些投票規則視為即使危機中也不可更改。

items.defEn: to weaken or damage in quality or function
items.usage: 常見 impair judgment / ability / vision。
items.exampleEn: Sleep deprivation impaired the pilots' reaction time in the simulator.
items.exampleZh: 睡眠不足削弱了飛行員在模擬器中的反應時間。

items.defEn: fair because not favoring either side
items.usage: 與 partial（偏袒的）相對；別和 passionate 搞混。
items.exampleEn: An impartial referee is essential if the ranking is to remain credible.
items.exampleZh: 排名若要可信，公正的裁判必不可少。

items.defEn: a deadlock in which no progress seems possible
items.usage: 談判、談判破裂常用 reach an impasse。
items.exampleEn: Talks reached an impasse over who would control the shared dataset.
items.exampleZh: 談判在誰掌控共享資料集上陷入僵局。

items.defEn: showing no emotion on the face or in manner
items.defZh: 無動於衷的；面無表情的
items.usage: 描述外表冷靜，不一定表示內心無情。
items.exampleEn: The defendant remained impassive as the verdict was read.
items.exampleZh: 宣讀判決時，被告始終面無表情。

items.defEn: to slow or block movement or progress
items.usage: 與 hamper 近義，受詞常是 progress / investigation。
items.exampleEn: Missing permits impeded construction for most of the quarter.
items.exampleZh: 許可缺失使施工在該季大部分時間受阻。

items.defEn: soon to happen, often with a threatening tone
items.usage: 與 imminent 極近，常帶威脅感。
items.exampleEn: Staff prepared contingency plans for the impending budget freeze.
items.exampleZh: 員工為即將到來的預算凍結擬定應變計畫。

items.defEn: not allowing liquid or other substances to pass through
items.usage: 科學語境常見；也可比喻「不受影響」。
items.exampleEn: The lining must be impermeable to solvents used in the process.
items.exampleZh: 襯裡必須不讓製程所用溶劑滲透。

items.defEn: not easily excited or disturbed
items.usage: 強調面對壓力仍保持平靜。
items.exampleEn: The chair remained imperturbable while the gallery erupted in protest.
items.exampleZh: 旁聽席爆發抗議時，主席依然沉著。

items.defEn: incapable of being affected or penetrated
items.usage: GRE 常考 impervious to criticism / reason。
items.exampleEn: He seemed impervious to evidence that contradicted his theory.
items.exampleZh: 他似乎對與理論相牴觸的證據無動於衷。

items.defEn: acting suddenly on impulse rather than thought
items.usage: 評行為「欠考慮」，常帶負面。
items.exampleEn: An impetuous reply to the reviewer damaged the author's case.
items.exampleZh: 對審稿人衝動回覆，損害了作者的立場。

items.defEn: impossible to appease or soften
items.defZh: 難以平息的；毫不妥協的
items.usage: 常修飾敵人、怒氣、反對。
items.exampleEn: The union faced implacable opposition to any change in seniority rules.
items.exampleZh: 工會面對對年資規則任何更動都毫不妥協的反對。

items.defEn: to put a plan, policy, or decision into effect
items.usage: GRE 多考動詞「落實政策」，較少考名詞「工具」。
items.exampleEn: The city implemented the new recycling schedule in March.
items.exampleZh: 該市於三月實施新的回收時程。

items.defEn: understood though not stated outright
items.usage: 與 explicit 相對；也可指 implicit trust（完全的信任）。
items.exampleEn: There was an implicit understanding that drafts would not be leaked.
items.exampleZh: 有一種不言而喻的默契：草稿不得外流。

items.defEn: to collapse inward from external pressure
items.usage: GRE 考「向內倒塌」，可指建築或組織瞬間潰敗。
items.exampleEn: The coalition imploded after its two largest parties withdrew.
items.exampleZh: 兩大黨退出後，該聯盟向內崩解。

items.defEn: to press with persistent, often annoying requests
items.usage: 強調反覆、令人厭煩的請求。
items.exampleEn: Lobbyists importuned the agency for exemptions they had already been denied.
items.exampleZh: 遊說者一再向機關懇求早已被拒的豁免。

items.defEn: a person who assumes a false identity to deceive
items.usage: 也可拼 imposter；重點是「假扮身份」。
items.exampleEn: The so-called consultant was an impostor with no engineering license.
items.exampleZh: 那位所謂顧問是沒有工程執照的冒牌者。

items.defEn: made poor in money, resources, or quality
items.usage: 可指經濟貧窮，也可指語言、土壤「貧瘠」。
items.exampleEn: Years of extraction left the region environmentally impoverished.
items.exampleZh: 多年開採使該地區在環境上變得貧瘠。

items.defEn: too strong to be captured or shaken
items.usage: 可指堡壘，也可比喻論點、地位。
items.exampleEn: With new data, the once impregnable theory began to look fragile.
items.exampleZh: 有了新數據，一度堅不可摧的理論顯得脆弱。

items.defEn: failing to plan or save for the future
items.usage: 與 provident（有遠見、節儉）相對。
items.exampleEn: Improvident spending in boom years left no reserve for the downturn.
items.exampleZh: 繁榮年沒有遠見的支出，使衰退時毫無儲備。

items.defEn: to invent or perform with little preparation
items.usage: 可指音樂即興，也可指臨場想辦法。
items.exampleEn: When the translator failed to arrive, the chair improvised a summary in two languages.
items.exampleZh: 翻譯未到，主席即興用兩種語言做了摘要。

items.defEn: unwise because it ignores risk or consequence
items.usage: 評判斷「欠考慮」，比 impudent（無禮）差一個字母。
items.exampleEn: Borrowing against the endowment was judged imprudent by the trustees.
items.exampleZh: 受託人認為以捐贈基金抵押借款並不謹慎。

items.defEn: boldly disrespectful; shamelessly rude
items.usage: 易與 imprudent 混淆：impudent = 沒禮貌。
items.exampleEn: The intern's impudent interruption of the keynote startled the panel.
items.exampleZh: 實習生無禮打斷專題演講，令與談人一愣。

items.defEn: to attack as false or questionable
items.defZh: 質疑；抨擊（真實性或動機）
items.usage: 受詞常是 integrity, motives, testimony。
items.exampleEn: Counsel tried to impugn the witness's motives rather than the facts.
items.exampleZh: 律師試圖質疑證人動機，而非事實本身。

items.defEn: not resulting from deliberate intent; accidental
items.usage: 常修飾錯誤：inadvertent omission / error。
items.exampleEn: An inadvertent swap of labels invalidated the entire trial batch.
items.exampleZh: 標籤無意間貼錯，使整批試驗失效。

items.defEn: empty of sense or substance; silly
items.usage: 評言論或問題「沒內容」。
items.exampleEn: The interview wasted time on inane questions about office snacks.
items.exampleZh: 訪談把時間浪費在關於辦公室零食的空洞問題上。

items.defEn: to begin formally or mark the start of
items.defZh: 正式開始；為……舉行就職／開幕
items.usage: 不必限於總統就職，也可 inaugurate a policy。
items.exampleEn: The museum inaugurated a new lending program for regional schools.
items.exampleZh: 博物館正式啟動面向區域學校的借展計畫。

items.defEn: tending to inflame conflict; designed to cause fire
items.usage: GRE 多考比喻義「煽風點火的言論」。
items.exampleEn: The editorial was incendiary enough to trigger a recall petition.
items.exampleZh: 那篇社論煽動性十足，引發了罷免連署。

items.defEn: to make extremely angry
items.usage: GRE 考動詞「激怒」，不是香（名詞 incense）。
items.exampleEn: The leaked memo incensed faculty who had been promised confidentiality.
items.exampleZh: 外洩備忘錄激怒了曾被承諾保密的教師。

items.defEn: the beginning of an institution, process, or idea
items.usage: from its inception 是高頻搭配。
items.exampleEn: From its inception, the clinic refused industry funding.
items.exampleZh: 該診所自創立之初就拒絕產業資金。

items.defEn: continuing without pause, often annoyingly
items.usage: 常帶厭煩感，如 incessant noise / complaints。
items.exampleEn: Incessant construction noise made concentration on campus impossible.
items.exampleZh: 不停的施工噪音使校園裡無法專心。

items.defEn: just begun and not yet fully formed
items.usage: GRE 愛考「尚不完整的計畫／情感」。
items.exampleEn: Her inchoate proposal still lacked a method for measuring outcomes.
items.exampleZh: 她未成形的提案仍缺少衡量成果的方法。

items.defEn: occurring as a minor accompaniment, not as the main point
items.usage: incidental to 表示「相對於主旨只是枝節」。
items.exampleEn: Travel costs were incidental to the study's larger sampling problem.
items.exampleZh: 差旅費相對於研究更大的抽樣問題只是附帶的。

items.defEn: cuttingly clear and penetrating in thought or expression
items.usage: 褒義，評分析或文筆「犀利」。
items.exampleEn: An incisive footnote exposed the gap in the author's causal claim.
items.exampleZh: 一則犀利的註腳揭開了作者因果主張的缺口。

items.defEn: to stir up action, often unrest or violence
items.usage: 法律語境常見 incite violence / riot。
items.exampleEn: The broadcast was accused of inciting unrest rather than reporting it.
items.exampleZh: 該廣播被指控煽動動亂，而非報導動亂。

items.defEn: a leaning or tendency toward something
items.usage: have an inclination to 表「傾向於做某事」。
items.exampleEn: The board showed little inclination to reopen a settled debate.
items.exampleZh: 董事會幾乎無意重開已結束的辯論。

items.defEn: out of keeping; not harmonious with the setting
items.usage: 強調與環境、語氣不合。
items.exampleEn: A comic soundtrack felt incongruous beside the documentary's grim footage.
items.exampleZh: 喜劇配樂配上紀錄片陰鬱畫面，顯得格格不入。

items.defEn: too minor to affect the outcome
items.defZh: 無關緊要的；無足輕重的
items.usage: 評細節「不影響大局」。
items.exampleEn: The typographical errors were inconsequential to the paper's main finding.
items.exampleZh: 錯字對論文主要發現無關緊要。

items.defEn: to include as part of a larger whole
items.usage: incorporate into 是常見搭配。
items.exampleEn: The revision incorporated three case studies from rural clinics.
items.exampleZh: 修訂版納入三則鄉村診所的個案。

items.defEn: incapable of being corrected or reformed
items.defZh: 屢教不改的；無可救藥的
items.usage: 可認真指惡習，也可半開玩笑指習慣。
items.exampleEn: He remained an incorrigible latecomer despite written warnings.
items.exampleZh: 即使有書面警告，他仍是屢教不改的遲到者。

items.defEn: unwilling or unable to believe
items.usage: 別與 incredible（難以置信的事物）搞混：incredulous 多形容人。
items.exampleEn: Reviewers were incredulous that the authors had skipped a control group.
items.exampleZh: 審稿人難以置信作者竟省略對照組。

items.defEn: a small, often regular increase
items.usage: 也可作動詞，但 GRE 多考名詞「小幅增加」。
items.exampleEn: Funding rose in modest increments rather than in a single leap.
items.exampleZh: 經費以小幅增量上升，而非一次躍進。

items.defEn: to make someone appear guilty of a crime or fault
items.usage: self-incriminating 指「自證其罪的」。
items.exampleEn: The recovered emails incriminated two managers in the bid-rigging scheme.
items.exampleZh: 找回的郵件顯示兩名經理涉入圍標。

items.defEn: imposed as a duty; currently holding an office
items.usage: GRE 常考 it is incumbent on/upon someone to…。
items.exampleEn: It is incumbent on the editor to disclose funding sources.
items.exampleZh: 揭露資金來源是編輯義不容辭的責任。

items.defEn: persisting without apparent tiredness
items.usage: 褒義，強調精力與毅力。
items.exampleEn: An indefatigable archivist reconstructed the missing decade of records.
items.exampleZh: 一位不知疲倦的檔案員重建了缺失十年的紀錄。

items.defEn: originating naturally in a particular place
items.usage: 可指人、植物或習俗「原產於某地」。
items.exampleEn: The reserve protects several indigenous grasses that stabilize the dunes.
items.exampleZh: 保護區守護數種能穩固沙丘的本土草類。

items.defEn: extremely poor; lacking basic means
items.usage: 法律、社會政策文本常見；勿與 indigenous 混淆。
items.exampleEn: The clinic offered free care to indigent patients without insurance.
items.exampleZh: 診所為無保險的貧困病患提供免費照護。

items.defEn: disposed to avoid exertion; lazy
items.usage: 醫學也可指「進展緩慢的」病變，GRE 多考「懶」。
items.exampleEn: An indolent committee delayed the safety review for months.
items.exampleZh: 懶散的委員會把安全審查拖了數月。

items.defEn: impossible to subdue or defeat
items.usage: 常修飾精神、意志。
items.exampleEn: Her indomitable optimism kept the fieldwork going after the storm.
items.exampleZh: 風暴過後，她不屈的樂觀使田野工作得以繼續。

items.defEn: to bring about or persuade into an action or state
items.usage: 可指誘發結果，也可指說服某人。
items.exampleEn: Lower interest rates induced firms to accelerate capital spending.
items.exampleZh: 較低利率促使企業加快資本支出。

items.defEn: too great or subtle to be expressed in words
items.usage: 多修飾感受、美、神聖。
items.exampleEn: Survivors spoke of an ineffable relief when the evacuation order came.
items.exampleZh: 撤離令下達時，倖存者說那是難以言喻的寬慰。

items.defEn: clumsy or incompetent in performance
items.usage: 評人「不稱職」，常接 at / in。
items.exampleEn: The inept handling of the recall deepened public distrust.
items.exampleZh: 召回處理笨拙，加深了公眾不信任。

items.defEn: lacking the power to move, act, or react
items.usage: 化學「惰性」與比喻「毫無作為」皆可考。
items.exampleEn: The legislature remained inert while the crisis widened.
items.exampleZh: 危機擴大時，立法機關仍毫無作為。

items.defEn: certain to happen; not avoidable
items.usage: the inevitable 可作名詞，指注定之事。
items.exampleEn: With two key suppliers bankrupt, delays were inevitable.
items.exampleZh: 兩家關鍵供應商破產，延誤不可避免。

items.defEn: impossible to stop or persuade; unrelenting
items.usage: 常修飾過程、命運、邏輯推進。
items.exampleEn: The inexorable rise in sea levels forced the port to redesign its docks.
items.exampleZh: 海平面無法阻擋的上升迫使港口重新設計碼頭。

items.defEn: well known for a bad quality or deed
items.usage: famous 是好名聲；infamous 是壞名聲。
items.exampleEn: The factory became infamous for concealing safety violations.
items.exampleZh: 該工廠因隱瞞安全違規而臭名昭著。

items.defEn: a conclusion drawn from evidence rather than direct statement
items.usage: GRE 閱讀核心：make / draw an inference。
items.exampleEn: From the missing citations, the editor drew an inference of hurried drafting.
items.exampleZh: 從缺失的引註，編輯推論草稿寫得倉促。

items.defEn: to introduce and spread through as if by pouring in
items.usage: infuse with 與 imbue with 近義。
items.exampleEn: The director infused the training with case studies from actual inspections.
items.exampleZh: 主任把實際檢查的個案注入訓練中。

items.defEn: cleverly inventive and resourceful
items.usage: 指「聰明靈巧」；勿與 ingenuous（天真）混淆。
items.exampleEn: An ingenious clamp let the team sample ice without fracturing the core.
items.exampleZh: 一個巧妙的夾具讓團隊取冰樣時不使岩心斷裂。

items.defEn: openly sincere and unsuspecting; naively frank
items.usage: GRE 高頻對比：ingenuous = 天真誠懇；ingenious = 機巧。
items.exampleEn: His ingenuous admission that he had not read the appendix surprised the panel.
items.exampleZh: 他坦率承認沒讀過附錄，令評審驚訝。

items.defEn: fixed deeply and firmly, as a habit or prejudice
items.usage: ingrained habit / bias 是常考搭配。
items.exampleEn: Ingrained distrust of outside auditors slowed the reform.
items.exampleZh: 對外部稽核根深蒂固的不信任拖慢了改革。

items.defEn: existing as a permanent, essential quality
items.usage: inherent in 表示「某事物本身就有的」。
items.exampleEn: Risk is inherent in any experiment that alters a live system.
items.exampleZh: 風險是任何改動運作中系統的實驗所固有的。

items.defEn: to restrain or hold back an action or process
items.usage: 科學與心理皆常用；受詞可為 growth / behavior。
items.exampleEn: High humidity inhibited the drying of the frescoes.
items.exampleZh: 高濕抑制了壁畫乾燥。

items.defEn: hostile or harmful in effect
items.usage: inimical to 後接「對……不利」。
items.exampleEn: Chronic underfunding is inimical to long-term conservation.
items.exampleZh: 長期資金不足對長期保育不利。

items.defEn: gross injustice or wickedness
items.usage: 語氣很重，指嚴重的不公或邪惡。
items.exampleEn: The report catalogued the iniquity of forced evictions without notice.
items.exampleZh: 報告羅列了未經通知強制驅離的不義。

items.defEn: present from birth rather than learned
items.usage: 與 acquired 相對；常修飾能力、傾向。
items.exampleEn: The study asked whether spatial skill is innate or trained.
items.exampleZh: 該研究探討空間能力是先天的還是訓練而得。

items.defEn: not harmful or offensive
items.usage: 可指言論「無惡意」，或物質「無毒」。
items.exampleEn: What seemed an innocuous joke undermined trust in the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 看似無害的玩笑，卻損害了會議中的信任。

items.defEn: introducing new methods or ideas
items.usage: 褒義為主，修飾方法、設計、政策。
items.exampleEn: An innovative sampling frame captured households without landlines.
items.exampleZh: 創新的抽樣架構涵蓋了沒有市話的家庭。

items.defEn: an indirect, often unpleasant hint or suggestion
items.usage: 多帶負面暗示，而非直接指控。
items.exampleEn: The column relied on innuendo instead of documented facts.
items.exampleZh: 那專欄靠影射，而非有紀錄的事實。

items.defEn: exceeding reasonable limits; excessive
items.usage: inordinate amount / delay / attention 為高頻搭配。
items.exampleEn: The project consumed an inordinate share of the annual budget.
items.exampleZh: 該專案消耗了年度預算中不成比例的份額。

items.defEn: impossible to satisfy
items.defZh: 無法滿足的；貪得無厭的
items.usage: 可中性（求知慾）或負面（貪婪）。
items.exampleEn: The lab's insatiable demand for computing time strained the cluster.
items.exampleZh: 實驗室對運算時間無法滿足的需求使叢集吃緊。

items.defEn: unaware, unresponsive, or lacking feeling
items.usage: GRE 常考 insensible to（對……無感），不是「無意義」。
items.exampleEn: He seemed insensible to the discomfort his remarks caused.
items.exampleZh: 他似乎未察覺自己的話造成的不快。

items.defEn: spreading harm gradually and deceptively
items.usage: 強調「慢慢侵蝕、不易察覺」。
items.exampleEn: An insidious bias in the sampling frame skewed every later estimate.
items.exampleZh: 抽樣架構中隱伏的偏差扭曲了之後每一次估計。

items.defEn: showing a deep, accurate understanding
items.usage: 褒義，評評論或分析「見地深」。
items.exampleEn: Her insightful reading of the footnotes changed the seminar's direction.
items.exampleZh: 她對註腳富洞察力的解讀改變了研討課方向。

items.defEn: to suggest something unpleasant in an indirect way
items.usage: 也可指慢慢鑽入；GRE 多考「含沙射影」。
items.exampleEn: The question insinuated that the data had been trimmed.
items.exampleZh: 那問題暗示數據曾被修剪。

items.defEn: lacking flavor, interest, or vigor
items.usage: 可指食物無味，或文章、人無趣。
items.exampleEn: The keynote was insipid, repeating slogans without evidence.
items.exampleZh: 專題演講乏味，只重複口號而無證據。

items.defEn: openly insulting in a contemptuous way
items.usage: 比 rude 更帶「公然輕蔑」。
items.exampleEn: An insolent reply to the judge drew an immediate reprimand.
items.exampleZh: 對法官傲慢無禮的回答立刻招來訓斥。

items.defEn: narrow in outlook, as if cut off like an island
items.usage: 字面「島嶼的」，GRE 多考「眼光狹窄」。
items.exampleEn: An insular hiring network kept new methods from entering the department.
items.exampleZh: 孤立的聘用網絡使新方法無法進入該系。

items.defEn: a person who rises in revolt against authority
items.usage: 也可作形容詞；政治、軍事文本常見。
items.exampleEn: Insurgents seized the radio station before dawn.
items.exampleZh: 叛亂者在黎明前佔領了電臺。

items.defEn: not able to be touched; not easily measured
items.usage: 商業上常對比 tangible assets。
items.exampleEn: Trust is an intangible asset that the scandal quickly eroded.
items.exampleZh: 信任是無形資產，醜聞很快將其侵蝕。

items.defEn: essential to completeness; forming a necessary part
items.defZh: 不可或缺的；構成整體的
items.usage: integral to 表示「對……必不可少」。
items.exampleEn: Peer review is integral to the journal's credibility.
items.exampleZh: 同儕審查對該期刊的可信度不可或缺。

items.defEn: moral honesty; the state of being whole and unimpaired
items.usage: 可指人格操守，也可指資料、結構「完好」。
items.exampleEn: Altering timestamps would compromise the integrity of the log.
items.exampleZh: 竄改時間戳會損害日誌的完整性。

items.defEn: lacking moderation, especially in speech or appetite
items.usage: 與 temperate 相對；常評言論或飲酒。
items.exampleEn: Intemperate remarks on live radio forced the host to apologize.
items.exampleZh: 直播電臺上無節制的言論迫使主持人道歉。

items.defEn: to plead or intervene on behalf of another
items.usage: intercede with A for B 表示向 A 為 B 說情。
items.exampleEn: A senior diplomat interceded to secure the researcher's release.
items.exampleZh: 一位資深外交官出面斡旋，以確保研究員獲釋。

items.defEn: to prohibit or intercept by official order
items.usage: 法律、軍事上「封禁、截斷供應」。
items.exampleEn: Customs interdicted a shipment of unlicensed medical devices.
items.exampleZh: 海關攔截了一批無許可的醫療器材。

items.defEn: to insert a remark abruptly into a conversation
items.usage: 中性或略負面，視場合而定。
items.exampleEn: She interjected a clarifying statistic before the motion was put to a vote.
items.exampleZh: 在動議付諸表決前，她插入一項澄清用的統計數字。

items.defEn: to hint or make known indirectly
items.usage: GRE 考動詞「暗示」，重音在最後音節；不是「親密的」。
items.exampleEn: The dean intimated that funding would be frozen, without saying so outright.
items.exampleZh: 院長暗示經費將凍結，卻未明說。

items.defEn: to frighten into submission or inaction
items.usage: 受詞是人；常出現在法律、職場語境。
items.exampleEn: Witnesses said they had been intimidated into withdrawing complaints.
items.exampleZh: 證人表示曾遭恐嚇而撤回申訴。

items.defEn: hard to manage, treat, or solve
items.usage: 可指人倔強，或問題難以解決。
items.exampleEn: Antibiotic resistance remains an intractable public-health problem.
items.exampleZh: 抗生素抗藥性仍是棘手的公共衛生問題。

items.defEn: refusing to compromise or change position
items.usage: 談判語境高頻；語氣負面居多。
items.exampleEn: Intransigent factions blocked every draft of the joint statement.
items.exampleZh: 不妥協的派系擋下聯合聲明的每一份草案。

items.defEn: fearless in facing danger or difficulty
items.usage: 褒義，常修飾探險者、記者。
items.exampleEn: Intrepid surveyors mapped the canyon after the landslide.
items.exampleZh: 無畏的測量員在山崩後繪製了峽谷地圖。

items.defEn: having many complexly interrelated parts
items.usage: 強調結構細密，不一定是「困難」本身。
items.exampleEn: The contract's intricate indemnity clauses delayed signing for weeks.
items.exampleZh: 合約錯綜的賠償條款使簽署延遲數週。

items.defEn: belonging to the essential nature of a thing
items.usage: intrinsic value / motivation 為常考搭配。
items.exampleEn: The stone's intrinsic interest lay in its unusual crystal structure.
items.exampleZh: 那塊石頭的內在價值在於其不尋常的晶體結構。

items.defEn: inclined to examine one's own thoughts and feelings
items.usage: 評性格或作品「向內觀照」。
items.exampleEn: The memoir is quietly introspective rather than sensational.
items.exampleZh: 這本回憶錄沉靜內省，而非聳動。

items.defEn: to flood; to overwhelm with a great quantity
items.usage: 比喻義「大量湧來」極常見。
items.exampleEn: The office was inundated with applications the day the fellowship opened.
items.exampleZh: 獎學金一開放，辦公室就被申請件淹沒。

items.defEn: to become accustomed to something unpleasant through exposure
items.usage: GRE 考 be inured to hardship / criticism。
items.exampleEn: Years of night shifts had inured the staff to irregular sleep.
items.exampleZh: 多年夜班使員工習慣了不規律睡眠。

items.defEn: harsh, abusive language used to attack
items.usage: 通常作不可數，指一類言辭。
items.exampleEn: The hearing descended into invective instead of policy debate.
items.exampleZh: 聽證會淪為謾罵，而非政策辯論。

items.defEn: firmly established by long habit
items.usage: 常接負面習慣：inveterate liar / gambler。
items.exampleEn: He was an inveterate annotator, filling every margin with queries.
items.exampleZh: 他是積習已深的批註者，每個頁邊都寫滿疑問。

items.defEn: likely to arouse resentment, envy, or ill will
items.defZh: 招人怨恨的；易引起不平的
items.usage: invidious comparison 指「令人反感的比較」。
items.exampleEn: Ranking labs by a single metric created invidious comparisons.
items.exampleZh: 用單一指標為實驗室排名造成招怨的比較。

items.defEn: to give energy, strength, or freshness
items.usage: 可指身體，也可指組織、討論。
items.exampleEn: New field data invigorated a debate that had gone stale.
items.exampleZh: 新的田野數據使已顯陳舊的辯論重新振奮。

items.defEn: easily provoked to anger
items.usage: 描述性情，不一定正在發脾氣。
items.exampleEn: The irascible director ended meetings the moment questions turned critical.
items.exampleZh: 那位易怒的主管一聽到批判性問題就結束會議。

items.defEn: extremely angry at a particular moment
items.usage: 指當下發怒，與 irascible（本性易怒）有別。
items.exampleEn: Irate residents packed the hearing after the overnight demolition.
items.exampleZh: 連夜拆除後，盛怒的居民擠滿聽證會。

items.defEn: marked by a contrast between expectation and reality, often with wry effect
items.usage: GRE 常考情境 ironic，不一定是嘲諷語氣。
items.exampleEn: It was ironic that the anti-waste campaign generated piles of unused flyers.
items.exampleZh: 反浪費運動卻製造成堆未使用傳單，頗具諷刺。

items.defEn: unable to decide or act firmly
items.usage: 與 resolute 相對。
items.exampleEn: An irresolute board postponed the vote three times.
items.exampleZh: 猶豫不決的董事會三次延後表決。

items.defEn: traveling from place to place, especially to work
items.usage: 常修飾 worker, preacher, judge。
items.exampleEn: Itinerant inspectors covered three counties in a single week.
items.exampleZh: 巡迴檢查員一週走訪三個郡。

items.defEn: a planned route or schedule of travel
items.usage: 旅行、考察計畫的時間表。
items.exampleEn: The field itinerary left no spare day for weather delays.
items.exampleZh: 實地行程沒有預留天氣延誤的備用日。

items.defEn: worn out or dulled by excess or overexposure
items.usage: 因過多經驗而失去新鮮感，非單純疲勞。
items.exampleEn: Jaded reviewers barely glanced at yet another incremental study.
items.exampleZh: 厭倦的審稿人幾乎不看又一篇增量式研究。

items.defEn: specialized language of a profession, often opaque to outsiders
items.usage: 可中性，也可批評「讓人聽不懂的術語」。
items.exampleEn: The grant call asked applicants to avoid jargon that hid weak methods.
items.exampleZh: 補助公告要求申請人避免用行話掩蓋薄弱方法。

items.defEn: colored by prejudice, envy, or cynicism
items.defZh: 有偏見的；帶嫉妒眼光的
items.usage: 字面「患黃疸的」，GRE 多考比喻「帶有色眼光」。
items.exampleEn: A jaundiced view of industry money made him dismiss useful partnerships.
items.exampleZh: 對產業資金帶偏見的看法使他否定有用的合作。

items.defEn: lacking maturity, substance, or interest
items.usage: 評論點「淺薄」，語氣偏書面。
items.exampleEn: The manifesto's jejune slogans did not survive expert scrutiny.
items.exampleZh: 宣言裡幼稚的口號經不起專家檢視。

items.defEn: to put at risk of loss or harm
items.usage: 受詞常是 safety, career, funding。
items.exampleEn: Leaking the embargoed paper could jeopardize the journal's credibility.
items.exampleZh: 洩漏禁刊論文可能危及期刊信譽。

items.defEn: given to or characterized by joking
items.usage: 語氣通常友善，不一定輕浮。
items.exampleEn: A jocular tone helped, but it did not replace a clear safety briefing.
items.exampleZh: 詼諧語氣有幫助，但不能取代清楚的安全簡報。

items.defEn: showing sound, careful judgment
items.usage: 褒義，評選擇或用詞「有分寸」。
items.exampleEn: Judicious pruning of the appendix made the argument easier to follow.
items.exampleZh: 審慎刪節附錄使論點更易跟隨。

items.defEn: to place side by side, especially for contrast
items.usage: 藝術與寫作分析高頻詞。
items.exampleEn: The exhibit juxtaposed wartime posters with private diaries from the same month.
items.exampleZh: 展覽把戰時海報與同月私人日記並置。

items.defEn: to start a fire; to awaken a feeling or interest
items.usage: 比喻義「激發興趣／熱情」更常考。
items.exampleEn: A single guest lecture kindled her interest in archival law.
items.exampleZh: 一場客座演講點燃了她對檔案法的興趣。

items.defEn: relating to motion or produced by movement
items.usage: 物理「動能」；藝術也可指動態的。
items.exampleEn: The sculpture's kinetic parts shifted with each change in wind speed.
items.exampleZh: 雕塑的動能部件隨風速變化而移動。

items.defEn: praise and honor for an achievement
items.usage: 作不可數；動詞用 get / deserve kudos。
items.exampleEn: The team earned kudos for publishing the negative results as well.
items.exampleZh: 團隊因一併發表陰性結果而獲得讚譽。

items.defEn: using few words, often with a dry brevity
items.usage: 源於古斯巴達（Laconia）；可褒可貶。
items.exampleEn: His laconic reply—"No"—ended a twenty-minute argument.
items.exampleZh: 他簡潔的回答「不」結束了二十分鐘的爭論。

items.defEn: to express grief or regret over
items.usage: 也可作名詞；GRE 動詞「哀嘆某事」常見。
items.exampleEn: Historians lamented the destruction of the municipal archive in the flood.
items.exampleZh: 歷史學者痛惜市立檔案在洪水中被毀。

items.defEn: to ridicule through satire
items.usage: 也可作名詞，指諷刺作品。
items.exampleEn: The campus paper lampooned the administration's contradictory memos.
items.exampleZh: 校園報諷刺校方自相矛盾的備忘錄。

items.defEn: lacking energy or vitality; sluggishly relaxed
items.usage: 可指人疲乏，或氣氛慵懶。
items.exampleEn: A languid afternoon session produced almost no decisions.
items.exampleZh: 一場懶洋洋的下午會議幾乎做不出任何決定。

items.defEn: the unlawful taking of another's property
items.usage: 法律術語；程度可分 grand / petty larceny。
items.exampleEn: The clerk was charged with larceny after inventory gaps were traced to his locker.
items.exampleZh: 庫存缺口追到他置物櫃後，那名職員被控竊盜。

items.defEn: a state of weariness or lack of energy
items.usage: 偏書面，指身心疲乏。
items.exampleEn: Mid-semester lassitude showed up in falling attendance.
items.exampleZh: 學期中段的倦怠反映在出席率下降。

items.defEn: present but not yet visible or active
items.usage: latent talent / defect / heat 皆可見。
items.exampleEn: The audit uncovered latent defects in the original survey design.
items.exampleZh: 稽核揭開原始調查設計中隱而未發的缺陷。

items.defEn: to praise highly
items.usage: 書面語；laudable 是「值得稱讚的」。
items.exampleEn: The citation lauded the nurse's calm during the blackout.
items.exampleZh: 褒獎文稱頌那位護理師在停電時的冷靜。

items.defEn: given or spending in great, often extravagant abundance
items.usage: 也可作動詞 lavish on（大肆給予）。
items.exampleEn: Lavish catering at a budget meeting sent the wrong signal to staff.
items.exampleZh: 預算會議上奢華的餐點向員工傳達了錯誤訊號。

items.defEn: abnormally drowsy or lacking energy
items.usage: 可指身體嗜睡，或組織反應遲鈍。
items.exampleEn: The market remained lethargic despite a cut in interest rates.
items.exampleZh: 即使降息，市場依然無精打采。

items.defEn: lightness of tone, especially when seriousness is expected
items.usage: GRE 常考「在嚴肅場合不該有的玩笑」。
items.exampleEn: Levity during the memorial struck several colleagues as misplaced.
items.exampleZh: 追悼場合的輕率令幾位同事覺得不合時宜。

items.defEn: a legal or practical disadvantage; something that holds one back
items.usage: 會計「負債」與比喻「包袱」皆考。
items.exampleEn: The candidate's past remarks became a liability in the runoff.
items.exampleZh: 候選人過往言論在決選中成了包袱。

items.defEn: a person who rejects moral restraint, especially in pleasure
items.defZh: 放蕩者；不受道德約束之人
items.usage: 多貶義；與 liberty（自由）相關但更指縱慾。
items.exampleEn: The biography refused to romanticize the poet as a charming libertine.
items.exampleZh: 傳記拒絕把詩人浪漫化成迷人的放蕩者。

items.defEn: disregarding sexual or moral restraints
items.usage: 比 liberal 負面得多，強調道德失控。
items.exampleEn: Censors attacked the play as licentious, though its satire was mainly political.
items.exampleZh: 審查者攻擊該劇放蕩，儘管諷刺主要是政治性的。

items.defEn: to treat as a celebrity or hero
items.usage: 常帶「過度崇拜」的意味。
items.exampleEn: The press lionized the intern before the methods had been replicated.
items.exampleZh: 方法尚未被重複驗證，媒體就把實習生捧成名人。

items.defEn: lacking energy, interest, or enthusiasm
items.usage: 與 languid 近，更強調提不起勁。
items.exampleEn: A listless audience asked no questions after the third identical slide deck.
items.exampleZh: 第三套相同投影片之後，無精打采的聽眾沒有提問。

items.defEn: gracefully flexible in movement
items.usage: 多形容身體或動作優美靈活。
items.exampleEn: The dancer's lithe recovery from a slip drew quiet applause.
items.exampleZh: 舞者柔軟敏捷地從一次滑步中恢復，贏得輕聲掌聲。

items.defEn: furiously angry; discolored as from a bruise
items.usage: GRE 多考「氣得發青」。
items.exampleEn: The dean was livid when she learned the embargo had been broken.
items.exampleZh: 院長得知禁刊令被打破時怒不可遏。

items.defEn: to feel intense dislike or disgust for
items.usage: 語氣強於 dislike；勿與 loath（不情願的）混淆。
items.exampleEn: Several reviewers loathed the paper's dismissive tone toward earlier work.
items.exampleZh: 幾位審稿人厭惡該文對先前研究的輕蔑語氣。

items.defEn: elevated in height, style, or ambition; sometimes haughtily so
items.usage: 可褒（志向高）可貶（高高在上）。
items.exampleEn: Lofty mission statements did not compensate for missing safety protocols.
items.exampleZh: 崇高的使命宣言彌補不了缺失的安全規程。

items.defEn: very talkative
items.usage: 可中性，過量時略帶貶義。
items.exampleEn: A loquacious witness buried the key date under twenty minutes of anecdote.
items.exampleZh: 話多的證人把關鍵日期埋在二十分鐘軼事裡。

items.defEn: clearly expressed; mentally clear
items.usage: 可指文筆清楚，或病人清醒。
items.exampleEn: A lucid flowchart replaced three pages of tangled prose.
items.exampleZh: 一張清晰的流程圖取代了三頁糾結的文字。

items.defEn: producing substantial profit
items.usage: 強調「賺錢」，不一定合法或高尚。
items.exampleEn: Consulting proved more lucrative than the academic post she declined.
items.exampleZh: 顧問工作比她放棄的教職更有利可圖。

items.defEn: so unreasonable as to invite ridicule
items.usage: 評主張「離譜到可笑」。
items.exampleEn: The claim that one survey proved nationwide consensus was ludicrous.
items.exampleZh: 聲稱一份調查就證明全國共識，荒謬可笑。

items.defEn: exaggeratedly mournful or gloomy in tone
items.usage: 常帶「哀傷得過頭、近乎做作」。
items.exampleEn: The lugubrious soundtrack made a routine farewell feel like a funeral.
items.exampleZh: 過於悲哀的配樂讓例行送別像葬禮。

items.defEn: emitting or seeming to emit light; strikingly clear and bright
items.usage: 可指光線，也可讚文筆「透亮」。
items.exampleEn: Her luminous explanation of Bayes' rule helped the whole seminar.
items.exampleZh: 她對貝氏定理透亮的解釋幫助了整場研討。

items.defEn: shockingly vivid, especially in a sensational or gruesome way
items.defZh: 聳人聽聞的；絢麗刺眼的
items.usage: 新聞、文學評「煽情、血腥或刺目」。
items.exampleEn: Lurid headlines obscured the study's cautious conclusions.
items.exampleZh: 聳動標題掩蓋了研究審慎的結論。

items.defEn: a crafty scheme, often secret and sinister
items.usage: 常用複數 machinations。
items.exampleEn: The inquiry exposed machinations to delay the safety vote.
items.exampleZh: 調查揭開拖延安全表決的陰謀。

items.defEn: a powerful whirlpool; a chaotic, violent rush of events
items.usage: 比喻「局勢混亂」極常見。
items.exampleEn: The merger threw the department into a maelstrom of overlapping duties.
items.exampleZh: 合併使部門陷入職責重疊的混亂漩渦。

items.defEn: generous and noble, especially toward a rival
items.usage: 強調對弱者或對手的大度。
items.exampleEn: A magnanimous concession on authorship order ended the stalemate.
items.exampleZh: 在作者排序上寬宏讓步，結束了僵局。

items.defEn: wishing or intending harm to others
items.usage: 與 benevolent 相對。
items.exampleEn: The court found no malevolent intent, only reckless procedure.
items.exampleZh: 法院未認定存心惡意，只有程序魯莽。

items.defEn: wrongdoing, especially by a public official
items.usage: 法律、公共治理高頻；指職務上的不法。
items.exampleEn: Auditors documented financial malfeasance in the procurement office.
items.exampleZh: 稽核人員記錄了採購處的財務瀆職。

items.defEn: the desire to harm someone
items.usage: 法律 with malice 表示「蓄意加害」。
items.exampleEn: The judge instructed the jury to decide whether the email showed malice.
items.exampleZh: 法官指示陪審團判斷該郵件是否顯示惡意。

items.defEn: to speak harmful untruths about; to slander
items.usage: 也可作形容詞「有害的」；GRE 動詞更常見。
items.exampleEn: Rivals maligned the chemist without offering contrary data.
items.exampleZh: 對手在沒有提出相反數據的情況下中傷那位化學家。

items.defEn: to fake illness in order to avoid duty
items.usage: GRE 經典詞：不是真病，是躲工作。
items.exampleEn: The supervisor suspected staff were malingering after the holiday weekend.
items.exampleZh: 主管懷疑員工在連假後裝病逃避。

items.defEn: able to be shaped or influenced
items.usage: 金屬可錘薄；比喻人、意見「可變」。
items.exampleEn: Public opinion on the tax proved more malleable than the poll suggested.
items.exampleZh: 對該稅的民意結果比民調顯示的更可變塑。

items.defEn: an official order or a strong authorization to act
items.usage: 也可作動詞；GRE 名詞「授權／命令」常見。
items.exampleEn: Voters gave the council a clear mandate to expand night-bus service.
items.exampleZh: 選民清楚授權市議會擴大夜間公車。

items.defEn: to show plainly; to make evident
items.usage: 也可作形容詞「明顯的」；動詞「顯現出來」常考。
items.exampleEn: Stress manifested itself in a sharp rise in error rates.
items.exampleZh: 壓力以錯誤率急升的方式顯現。

items.defEn: to spoil or damage the quality of
items.usage: 受詞常是 reputation, surface, occasion。
items.exampleEn: A single uncredited quotation marred an otherwise careful chapter.
items.exampleZh: 一處未註明來源的引文損害了原本謹慎的一章。

items.defEn: a rigid disciplinarian who demands strict obedience
items.usage: 源自法國軍官名；帶貶義「死守規矩」。
items.exampleEn: The new coach was a martinet about attendance but flexible about tactics.
items.exampleZh: 新教練對出席極嚴苛，對戰術卻有彈性。

items.defEn: tearfully or weakly sentimental
items.defZh: 感傷過度的；哭哭啼啼的
items.usage: 評情感「濫情、不夠克制」。
items.exampleEn: The documentary turned maudlin in its final ten minutes of slow-motion farewells.
items.exampleZh: 紀錄片最後十分鐘慢動作告別變得濫情。

items.defEn: an independent person who refuses to follow the group
items.usage: 可褒（獨立思考）可貶（不合作）。
items.exampleEn: A maverick engineer published the dissenting report under her own name.
items.exampleZh: 一位特立獨行的工程師以自己名義發表異議報告。

items.defEn: a concise general principle or rule of conduct
items.usage: 短句、可記誦的原則。
items.exampleEn: The lab's working maxim was "measure twice, code once."
items.exampleZh: 實驗室的工作格言是「量兩次，寫一次程式」。

items.defEn: deficient in quantity or quality; scanty
items.usage: 修飾數量、證據、薪水。
items.exampleEn: The committee rejected the proposal for meager supporting data.
items.exampleZh: 委員會因佐證資料貧乏而否決提案。

items.defEn: to act as a go-between in order to settle a dispute
items.usage: mediate between A and B。
items.exampleEn: A retired judge mediated between the university and the contractors.
items.exampleZh: 一位退休法官在大學與承包商之間調解。

items.defEn: of only ordinary quality; not very good
items.usage: 明確貶義，不是「中等偏好」。
items.exampleEn: Mediocre replication studies still crowd out more ambitious designs.
items.exampleZh: 平庸的重複研究仍排擠了更大膽的設計。

items.defEn: sad in a lingering, thoughtful way
items.usage: 也可作名詞「憂鬱」；語氣較文學。
items.exampleEn: A melancholy tone ran through the letters written after the expedition failed.
items.exampleZh: 探險失敗後寫的信件通篇帶著憂鬱語氣。

items.defEn: sweet and smooth-sounding, as if flowing with honey
items.usage: 多形容聲音、語調、音樂。
items.exampleEn: The narrator's mellifluous delivery made dense legal history listenable.
items.exampleZh: 旁白甜美流暢的講述使濃密的法律史變得好聽。

items.defEn: motivated chiefly by money rather than loyalty or principle
items.usage: GRE 常考形容詞「為錢」，不只是「雇傭兵」。
items.exampleEn: Critics called the endorsement mercenary because the author had never used the product.
items.exampleZh: 批評者稱該背書唯利是圖，因為作者從未用過該產品。

items.defEn: liable to sudden, unpredictable change of mood or mind
items.usage: 源自水星／汞；可帶才思敏捷之意，GRE 多考善變。
items.exampleEn: The director's mercurial priorities made long-term planning nearly impossible.
items.exampleZh: 主管反覆無常的優先順序使長期規劃幾乎不可能。

items.defEn: attractive in a cheap, showy, or deceptive way
items.defZh: 金玉其外的；華而不實的
items.usage: GRE 難題詞：外表誘人但無實質。
items.exampleEn: Meretricious graphics could not hide the study's tiny sample.
items.exampleZh: 華而不實的圖表掩蓋不了研究樣本過小。

items.defEn: to hold spellbound; to fascinate completely
items.usage: 源自催眠術士 Mesmer；現多指深深吸引。
items.exampleEn: The slow-motion footage of the glacier calving mesmerized the audience.
items.exampleZh: 冰川崩解的慢動作畫面使觀眾入迷。

items.defEn: a complete or marked change of form, structure, or character
items.usage: 可指生物變態，也可比喻人的性格或制度大改。
items.exampleEn: The company underwent a metamorphosis after the new director arrived.
items.exampleZh: 新主管到任後，公司經歷了一場徹底轉變。

items.defEn: painstakingly attentive to minute details
items.defZh: 一絲不苟的；極為細心的
items.usage: GRE 常用來稱讚嚴謹的研究或編輯態度，帶正面精準感。
items.exampleEn: The archivist was meticulous in dating every manuscript fragment.
items.exampleZh: 檔案管理員為每一片手稿殘頁斷代時都一絲不苟。

items.defEn: spirit and fortitude under pressure
items.usage: 易與 metal 混淆；test someone's mettle 指考驗其魄力。
items.exampleEn: The crisis tested the governor's mettle more than any campaign speech could.
items.exampleZh: 這場危機比任何競選演說都更能考驗州長的膽識。

items.defEn: the social or cultural setting in which something occurs
items.usage: 偏學術／文學用語，指人物所處的文化或社會氛圍。
items.exampleEn: The novel captures the intellectual milieu of postwar Paris with unusual precision.
items.exampleZh: 這部小說異常精準地捕捉了戰後巴黎的知識分子氛圍。

items.defEn: extremely small; tiny to the point of being almost negligible
items.usage: 不要寫成 miniscule（常見拼錯）；程度比 small 更極端。
items.exampleEn: The laboratory detected only a minuscule trace of the compound in the sample.
items.exampleZh: 實驗室在樣本中只測到極微量的該化合物。

items.defEn: a person who distrusts or dislikes humankind
items.usage: 強調對「人」本身的厭惡，不只是害羞或孤僻。
items.exampleEn: The critic was no misanthrope, yet he had little patience for fashionable hypocrisy.
items.exampleZh: 那位評論家並非厭世者，卻難以忍受時髦的虛偽。

items.defEn: to interpret wrongly; to take in a mistaken sense
items.usage: 對象常是動機、語氣或含意，不一定是字面翻譯錯誤。
items.exampleEn: Readers should not misconstrue the author's irony as an endorsement of the policy.
items.exampleZh: 讀者不應把作者的反諷曲解成對該政策的背書。

items.defEn: stingy to a mean and grasping degree
items.usage: 比 frugal 負面；frugal 是節儉，miserly 是吝嗇刻薄。
items.exampleEn: The foundation refused the miserly offer that would have funded only a single scholarship.
items.exampleZh: 基金會拒絕了那筆吝嗇到只夠贊助一個獎學金的提議。

items.defEn: a name that is wrongly or inaccurately applied
items.usage: 句子常是 “X is a misnomer”，指名稱與實際不符。
items.exampleEn: Calling the sparsely attended session a “public forum” was a misnomer.
items.exampleZh: 把那場門可羅雀的會議稱為「公開論壇」，根本是誤稱。

items.defEn: to make less severe, harsh, or painful
items.usage: 減輕程度，通常無法徹底消除；常考 mitigate risk / harm。
items.exampleEn: New ventilation standards helped mitigate, but did not eliminate, indoor air hazards.
items.exampleZh: 新的通風標準有助於減輕、但未能消除室內空氣危害。

items.defEn: a device or pattern that aids memory; serving to assist recall
items.usage: 可作名詞（助記口訣）或形容詞（助記的）；GRE 兩者都可能考。
items.exampleEn: The instructor offered a mnemonic for recalling the stages of cell division.
items.exampleZh: 講師提供了一套記憶術，幫助記住細胞分裂的各個階段。

items.defEn: to adjust or vary in degree, tone, or intensity
items.usage: 可指聲音、政策力道或訊號強弱的調節，不一定是音樂轉調。
items.exampleEn: A skilled diplomat can modulate criticism so that it remains candid without becoming hostile.
items.exampleZh: 高明的外交官能調節批評的力道，使其坦誠卻不至於敵對。

items.defEn: to soothe anger or soften resistance
items.usage: 對象多是憤怒或敵對情緒，接近 appease、assuage。
items.exampleEn: A public apology did little to mollify investors after the accounting scandal.
items.exampleZh: 會計醜聞之後，一紙公開道歉幾乎安撫不了投資人。

items.defEn: of great consequence; historically or morally weighty
items.usage: 勿與 momentary（片刻的）混淆；momentous 強調分量而非短暫。
items.exampleEn: Ratifying the treaty was a momentous decision for the young republic.
items.exampleZh: 批准該條約對這個年輕共和國而言是影響深遠的決定。

items.defEn: austere and self-denying, as in a monastery
items.defZh: 修道院式的；清苦禁慾的
items.usage: 常比喻生活極度簡樸、與世隔絕，不一定真的當修士。
items.exampleEn: She adopted a monastic routine of dawn study and few social engagements.
items.exampleZh: 她過著近乎修道院式的作息：黎明苦讀，幾乎不社交。

items.defEn: tediously uniform in tone, pitch, or character
items.usage: 不只指聲音平淡，也可形容工作或論證缺乏變化。
items.exampleEn: The report's monotonous recitation of statistics failed to persuade the committee.
items.exampleZh: 報告單調地堆砌統計數字，未能說服委員會。

items.defEn: a formally agreed pause or suspension of activity
items.usage: 法律／政策詞：暫時停止某行為，不是永久廢除。
items.exampleEn: The city imposed a moratorium on new high-rise permits pending an environmental review.
items.exampleZh: 在環境評估完成前，市政府暫停核發新的高樓建照。

items.defEn: unhealthily preoccupied with death, disease, or grim subjects
items.defZh: 病態的；不健康地迷戀陰暗事物的
items.usage: GRE 多指心理上的病態興趣，不只是「生病的」。
items.exampleEn: The documentary was accused of taking a morbid interest in the victims' final hours.
items.exampleZh: 有人批評這部紀錄片病態地關注受害者臨終前的幾個小時。

items.defEn: near death; stagnant and on the verge of collapse
items.usage: 可指人、產業或制度「名存實亡、行將就木」。
items.exampleEn: Without new funding, the once-famous journal appeared moribund.
items.exampleZh: 若無新資金，這份昔日知名的期刊看起來已奄奄一息。

items.defEn: sullenly gloomy and ill-humored
items.usage: 描述性情陰沉、不愛說話，比 sad 更帶著慍怒。
items.exampleEn: After the verdict, the normally genial counsel grew morose and withdrawn.
items.exampleZh: 判決之後，原本和藹的律師變得陰鬱而封閉。

items.defEn: ordinary and worldly rather than elevated or imaginative
items.usage: 可貶（乏味）也可中性（日常俗務，對比精神／宗教層面）。
items.exampleEn: Even a brilliant theorist must attend to the mundane details of grant paperwork.
items.exampleZh: 即使是出色的理論家，也得處理申請補助這種世俗瑣事。

items.defEn: extremely generous in giving
items.usage: 程度強於 generous，常形容捐贈、贊助規模很大。
items.exampleEn: A munificent bequest allowed the museum to acquire the entire collection.
items.exampleZh: 一筆極其慷慨的遺贈使博物館得以購得整批藏品。

items.defEn: liable to change; not fixed in form or character
items.usage: 法律與科學文本中常見；反義常是 immutable。
items.exampleEn: Public opinion on the reform proved highly mutable in the months before the vote.
items.exampleZh: 公投前幾個月，民意對這項改革顯得極為易變。

items.defEn: shortsighted, literally or in failing to see long-term consequences
items.usage: GRE 幾乎都考比喻義：缺乏遠見，不只是視力問題。
items.exampleEn: Myopic budget cuts saved money this year but weakened the research pipeline.
items.exampleZh: 短視的預算刪減今年省了錢，卻削弱了研究後備力量。

items.defEn: a great and indefinitely large number; countless
items.usage: 可作形容詞（myriad problems）或名詞（a myriad of）；GRE 兩者皆可。
items.exampleEn: The expedition faced myriad logistical obstacles before reaching the plateau.
items.exampleZh: 探險隊抵達高原前，遭遇了無數後勤障礙。

items.defEn: the lowest point, especially of fortune or quality
items.usage: 反義是 zenith；常用於聲望、士氣或市場的最低潮。
items.exampleEn: Morale in the department reached its nadir after three consecutive failed audits.
items.exampleZh: 連續三次稽核失敗後，該部門士氣跌至谷底。

items.defEn: lacking worldly experience or sophistication; overly trusting
items.usage: 學術語境可中性（未經世故），更多時候暗示判斷不夠老練。
items.exampleEn: It would be naive to assume that the rival firm will share data without safeguards.
items.exampleZh: 若假定對手公司會在毫無保障下分享資料，未免太天真。

items.defEn: just coming into existence; not yet fully formed
items.usage: 強調「剛開始、尚未成熟」，常用於產業、民主或理論。
items.exampleEn: Investors watched the nascent industry with interest but withheld large commitments.
items.exampleZh: 投資人關注這個萌芽中的產業，卻暫不投入大筆資金。

items.defEn: vague, cloudy, or ill-defined
items.usage: 字面與星雲有關，GRE 多指概念、計畫或責任界線不清楚。
items.exampleEn: The guidelines remained too nebulous to give researchers a workable protocol.
items.exampleZh: 指導方針過於含混，無法讓研究人員形成可操作的程序。

items.defEn: openly wicked or criminal in purpose
items.usage: 語氣很重，用來形容陰謀、詐欺等明顯惡行。
items.exampleEn: Prosecutors outlined a nefarious scheme to siphon public funds into shell companies.
items.exampleZh: 檢察官勾勒出一套把公帑抽進空殼公司的邪惡計謀。

items.defEn: to nullify or make ineffective; to deny the truth of
items.usage: 可指邏輯上否定，或實際上抵銷先前努力。
items.exampleEn: A single contaminated sample can negate months of otherwise careful fieldwork.
items.exampleZh: 一份受污染的樣本，就能使數月嚴謹的田野工作化為無效。

items.defEn: carelessly failing to exercise due attention or duty
items.usage: 法律色彩濃：該注意而未注意；比 careless 更正式。
items.exampleEn: The hospital was found negligent in monitoring the patient's vital signs overnight.
items.exampleZh: 院方被認定在夜間監測病人生命徵象上有所疏忽。

items.defEn: an unbeatable rival or a source of downfall
items.usage: 可指長期對手，也可指導致某人失敗的力量。
items.exampleEn: Rising interest rates proved the speculative fund's nemesis.
items.exampleZh: 不斷攀升的利率成了那檔投機基金的剋星。

items.defEn: a beginner; a recent convert or novice
items.usage: 比 beginner 正式，可指剛入行或剛皈依某信念的人。
items.exampleEn: Even a neophyte in statistics could see that the sample was too small.
items.exampleZh: 即使是統計學新手也能看出樣本數太小。

items.defEn: to irritate or provoke, as if by stinging
items.usage: GRE 多考動詞「惹怒」，不要只記蕁麻這種植物。
items.exampleEn: The senator was nettled by questions that implied a conflict of interest.
items.exampleZh: 有問題暗示利益衝突，令那位參議員頗為惱怒。

items.defEn: offensive to the senses, especially smell; highly objectionable
items.defZh: 惡臭的；令人作嘔厭惡的
items.usage: GRE 陷阱：不是 noisy（吵鬧），而是惡臭或令人厭惡。
items.exampleEn: Investigators recoiled from the noisome odor in the abandoned warehouse.
items.exampleZh: 調查人員被廢棄倉庫裡的惡臭熏得直往後退。

items.defEn: wandering from place to place; having no fixed home
items.usage: 可指傳統遊牧，也可比喻職業上不斷遷徙。
items.exampleEn: The research team led a nomadic existence, moving from one field site to another.
items.exampleZh: 研究團隊過著近乎遊牧的生活，從一個田野地點遷到下一個。

items.defEn: appearing calmly unconcerned or casually indifferent
items.defZh: 漠不關心的；一派輕鬆的
items.usage: 外表冷靜，可能是真淡定，也可能是故作不在乎。
items.exampleEn: She gave a nonchalant shrug, as if the budget overrun were a minor inconvenience.
items.exampleZh: 她一派輕鬆地聳聳肩，彷彿預算超支只是小事一樁。

items.defEn: lacking distinctive features; dull and hard to characterize
items.defZh: 毫無特色的；難以形容的
items.usage: 強調「沒有辨識度」，常形容建築、外貌或文風平庸。
items.exampleEn: The headquarters occupied a nondescript office block on the edge of town.
items.exampleZh: 總部設在市郊一棟毫無特色的辦公大樓裡。

items.defEn: so perplexed as to be unsure how to act or speak
items.usage: GRE 標準義是「困惑」；部分美式口語誤用作「鎮定」，考試勿跟。
items.exampleEn: The committee sat nonplussed when the witness contradicted the official record.
items.exampleZh: 證人與官方紀錄互相矛盾時，委員會成員一時不知所措。

items.defEn: a wistful longing for a past time or place
items.usage: 帶感傷色彩，不一定客觀；可能美化過去。
items.exampleEn: The memoir mixes sharp political analysis with nostalgia for a vanished campus culture.
items.exampleZh: 這本回憶錄把犀利的政治分析，與對消逝校園文化的懷舊交織在一起。

items.defEn: widely known for something discreditable
items.defZh: 惡名昭彰的；聲名狼藉的
items.usage: famous 是出名，notorious 幾乎都是「因壞事而出名」。
items.exampleEn: The laboratory was notorious for sloppy peer review and rushed publications.
items.exampleZh: 那間實驗室因草率的同儕審查與倉促發表而惡名昭彰。

items.defEn: new and original; refreshingly unlike what has come before
items.usage: GRE 考形容詞「新穎」，不要看成名詞「小說」。
items.exampleEn: The team proposed a novel method for mapping underground water reserves.
items.exampleZh: 團隊提出一種新穎的方法來繪製地下水儲量圖。

items.defEn: a person new to an activity or field
items.usage: 與 neophyte 接近；可指宗教見習者，GRE 多指行業新手。
items.exampleEn: A novice in archival research should not handle fragile manuscripts unassisted.
items.exampleZh: 檔案研究的新手不應在無人協助下觸碰易損手稿。

items.defEn: harmful or poisonous to health, morals, or the environment
items.usage: 可指氣體、言論或影響力「有害」，比 harmful 更正式。
items.exampleEn: Regulators banned the noxious solvent after workers developed respiratory illness.
items.exampleZh: 工人出現呼吸道疾病後，主管機關禁用了那種有害溶劑。

items.defEn: a subtle shade of meaning, feeling, or distinction
items.usage: 強調精微層次；抓 nuance 常是高分閱讀理解的關鍵。
items.exampleEn: The translation captured the argument's logic but missed several tonal nuances.
items.exampleZh: 譯文抓住了論證邏輯，卻漏掉了若干語氣上的細微差別。

items.defEn: to foster growth, development, or care over time
items.usage: 可指養育孩子，也可比喻培養人才、關係或想法。
items.exampleEn: Good graduate programs nurture independent judgment rather than mere technical skill.
items.exampleZh: 優良的研究所培育的是獨立判斷，而不只是技術能力。

items.defEn: stubbornly unyielding, especially to persuasion or pity
items.usage: 比 obstinate 更硬：常暗示對勸說、憐憫都無動於衷。
items.exampleEn: The board remained obdurate despite testimony from injured workers.
items.exampleZh: 儘管受傷工人出庭作證，董事會仍頑固不改。

items.defEn: to make obscure or confusing, often deliberately
items.usage: 常帶負面：用複雜語言把事情搞糊，掩蓋真相。
items.exampleEn: The contract's footnotes seemed designed to obfuscate the true cost of the loan.
items.exampleZh: 合約註腳彷彿專門用來掩蓋貸款的真實成本。

items.defEn: to wipe out completely so that nothing remains
items.usage: 程度極強，指消滅到幾乎不留痕跡。
items.exampleEn: The flood obliterated the village's irrigation network within hours.
items.exampleZh: 洪水在數小時內徹底摧毀了村莊的灌溉網絡。

items.defEn: unaware or unmindful of what is happening around one
items.usage: 搭配 of / to；不是「健忘」那麼簡單，而是當下毫無察覺。
items.exampleEn: Walking and reading, he was oblivious to the protest forming in the square.
items.exampleZh: 他邊走邊讀，對廣場上正在集結的抗議渾然不覺。

items.defEn: harsh public condemnation or the disgrace it brings
items.usage: 正式書面語，指公眾辱罵或其帶來的恥辱。
items.exampleEn: The minister resigned amid a storm of obloquy over the leaked files.
items.exampleZh: 部長在外洩文件引發的公開譴責風暴中辭職。

items.defEn: not well known or not clearly understood; to conceal from view
items.defZh: 晦澀的；默默無聞的；使模糊
items.usage: 形容詞可指難懂或不出名；動詞指遮掩。GRE 兩種詞性都考。
items.exampleEn: Technical jargon should not obscure the study's central finding.
items.exampleZh: 專業術語不應掩蓋這項研究的核心發現。

items.defEn: excessively eager to please or obey, in a fawning way
items.usage: 負面：討好權勢，失去獨立判斷。
items.exampleEn: Obsequious aides told the director only what he wanted to hear.
items.exampleZh: 諂媚的助手只告訴主管他愛聽的話。

items.defEn: no longer in use or no longer suited to present needs
items.usage: 科技、方法或觀念「被淘汰」，不一定已經完全消失。
items.exampleEn: Paper punch cards are obsolete in modern data processing, yet they shaped early computing.
items.exampleZh: 穿孔卡片在現代資料處理中已過時，卻曾塑造早期運算。

items.defEn: stubbornly clinging to an opinion or course
items.usage: 中性可指堅持，GRE 多偏負面：不肯聽勸。
items.exampleEn: The committee grew frustrated with his obstinate refusal to consider a compromise.
items.exampleZh: 他固執地拒絕考慮妥協，令委員會頗為沮喪。

items.defEn: noisily defiant and hard to control
items.defZh: 喧鬧不服管束的；吵嚷反抗的
items.usage: 不只是吵，還帶「喧囂地不服從」。
items.exampleEn: Obstreperous shareholders interrupted the annual meeting with shouted accusations.
items.exampleZh: 喧鬧不服的股東以高聲指責打斷了股東年會。

items.defEn: slow to understand; blunt in perception or sensitivity
items.usage: GRE 多指智力或感受遲鈍，不只是幾何上的鈍角。
items.exampleEn: Only an obtuse reader would miss the satire in the closing paragraph.
items.exampleZh: 只有遲鈍的讀者才會錯過結尾段的諷刺。

items.defEn: to make unnecessary by removing the need or difficulty
items.usage: GRE 高頻陷阱：不是「避開危險」那麼籠統，而是「讓某事變得不必做」。
items.exampleEn: A reliable public archive would obviate the need for each scholar to rebuild the dataset.
items.exampleZh: 可靠的公共檔案庫可使學者不必各自重建資料集。

items.defEn: to block or shut off a passage
items.usage: GRE 考「堵住」；醫學上 occlude an artery，也可指視線被擋。
items.exampleEn: Inflammation can occlude the airway and make breathing dangerously difficult.
items.exampleZh: 發炎可能堵塞氣道，使呼吸變得極度困難。

items.defEn: arousing intense disgust or hatred
items.usage: 語氣強烈，用於行為、制度或氣味上的深惡痛絕。
items.exampleEn: Historians described the statute as an odious relic of racial exclusion.
items.exampleZh: 史家把該法條描述為種族排斥的可憎遺跡。

items.defEn: meddlesomely offering unwanted help or authority
items.defZh: 好管閒事的；愛擺官架子的
items.usage: GRE 陷阱：不是 official（官方的），而是愛插手、討人厭地熱心。
items.exampleEn: An officious clerk insisted on checking bags that had already been cleared.
items.exampleZh: 一名好管閒事的職員堅持要再查已經放行的袋子。

items.defEn: suggesting that something bad is coming
items.usage: 描述徵兆、沉默或數據「看起來不妙」。
items.exampleEn: An ominous silence followed the announcement of the preliminary results.
items.exampleZh: 初步結果宣布之後，現場陷入不祥的沉默。

items.defEn: having unlimited power or authority
items.usage: 常帶誇張或諷刺，用來批評權力過大的機構。
items.exampleEn: No regulator is omnipotent, however broad its statutory mandate may appear.
items.exampleZh: 無論法定職權看起來多廣，沒有任何監管機構是全能的。

items.defEn: burdensome; involving heavy obligation or effort
items.usage: 法律與政策文本常見：onerous requirements / duties。
items.exampleEn: Small clinics found the new reporting rules onerous and poorly designed.
items.exampleZh: 小型診所認為新的申報規定繁重且設計不良。

items.defEn: not transparent; hard to see through or to understand
items.usage: 字面指光線穿不透；比喻指論證或程序不透明。
items.exampleEn: The agency's opaque funding formula frustrated even experienced auditors.
items.exampleZh: 該機構不透明的經費公式，連資深稽核都感到挫折。

items.defEn: public disgrace arising from shameful conduct
items.usage: 比 criticism 更重，強調公眾羞辱與道德譴責。
items.exampleEn: The bank earned widespread opprobrium for concealing losses from depositors.
items.exampleZh: 該銀行隱瞞虧損、欺騙存戶，招來廣泛恥辱。

items.defEn: ostentatiously rich or lavishly abundant
items.usage: 可形容財富、裝潢或文風的華麗豐盛。
items.exampleEn: The embassy reception was held in an opulent hall lined with gilt mirrors.
items.exampleZh: 使館招待會在一間鑲金鏡子的奢華大廳舉行。

items.defEn: elaborately decorated or stylistically embellished
items.defZh: 裝飾華麗的；辭藻繁複的
items.usage: 可指建築，也可批評文章過分雕琢。
items.exampleEn: An ornate prose style can distract readers from an otherwise sound argument.
items.exampleZh: 華麗繁複的文風，可能讓讀者忽略原本站得住腳的論證。

items.defEn: conforming to established doctrine or conventional practice
items.usage: 可指宗教教義，也可指學科裡的主流看法。
items.exampleEn: Her conclusion challenged orthodox assumptions about voter turnout.
items.exampleZh: 她的結論挑戰了關於投票率的正統假設。

items.defEn: to swing back and forth between positions or opinions
items.usage: 物理上可指振動；GRE 常比喻態度左右搖擺。
items.exampleEn: The cabinet oscillated between austerity and stimulus for most of the year.
items.exampleZh: 內閣在那一年大部分時間裡，在緊縮與刺激之間來回擺盪。

items.defEn: stated or appearing as such, but perhaps not the real reason
items.defZh: 表面上的；聲稱的（未必真實）
items.usage: GRE 核心：表面如此，實際可能另有原因；常修飾 reason / purpose。
items.exampleEn: The ostensible aim of the merger was efficiency; the real prize was market control.
items.exampleZh: 這樁併購表面上是為了效率，真正的獎品卻是市場掌控。

items.defEn: showy in a way meant to impress or attract notice
items.usage: 負面：故意展示財富或才華以引人注目。
items.exampleEn: Ostentatious displays of philanthropy can undermine the sincerity of the gift.
items.exampleZh: 炫耀式的慈善展示，可能削弱捐贈的誠意。

items.defEn: to exclude from a group by general consent
items.usage: 源自古雅典放逐制；今多指社交或專業圈子的排擠。
items.exampleEn: Colleagues who reported the fraud were ostracized rather than protected.
items.exampleZh: 舉報詐欺的同事不但未受保護，反而遭到排斥。

items.defEn: to force out of a position or place
items.usage: 對象常是職位、政權或佔有者，帶強制色彩。
items.exampleEn: Shareholders voted to oust the chief executive after the earnings restatement.
items.exampleZh: 財報重編之後，股東投票罷黜了執行長。

items.defEn: to surpass or leave behind, especially in progress or performance
items.usage: 常指速度、成長或需求「跑贏」供給或對手。
items.exampleEn: Demand for the vaccine quickly outstripped the factory's production capacity.
items.exampleZh: 疫苗需求迅速超越工廠的產能。

items.defEn: arrogantly domineering; insisting on one's own way
items.usage: 描述以氣勢壓人，使人難以反駁或拒絕。
items.exampleEn: An overbearing chair can silence dissenting voices in a supposedly open forum.
items.exampleZh: 盛氣凌人的主席，能在號稱公開的討論中壓制異議。

items.defEn: open and observable; not hidden
items.usage: 反義常是 covert；overt discrimination 指公然歧視。
items.exampleEn: The statute banned overt religious tests for public office.
items.exampleZh: 該法禁止對公職人員施加公開的宗教檢驗。

items.defEn: excessively agitated or excessively elaborate
items.defZh: 過度緊張的；過分雕琢的
items.usage: 可指情緒激動過度，也可指藝術／文風過於繁複。
items.exampleEn: The overwrought finale weakened an otherwise disciplined documentary.
items.exampleZh: 過度煽情的結尾，削弱了這部原本克制的紀錄片。

items.defEn: to restore calm or to quell unrest
items.usage: 可安撫個人怒氣，也可指平定動亂；注意可能帶「以讓步換平靜」的批評。
items.exampleEn: Emergency talks were convened to pacify striking transit workers.
items.exampleZh: 當局召開緊急會談，以平息捷運工人的罷工。

items.defEn: acceptable to the taste or to the mind
items.usage: GRE 常考比喻義：方案、妥協「讓人吞得下去」。
items.exampleEn: The compromise was barely palatable to either union, but both signed.
items.exampleZh: 這項妥協對兩個工會都幾乎難以接受，但雙方還是簽了。

items.defEn: resembling a palace in size or splendor
items.usage: 強調規模與豪華，常帶一點誇張或諷刺。
items.exampleEn: Critics mocked the palatial new headquarters as a monument to executive vanity.
items.exampleZh: 批評者嘲笑那座宮殿般的新總部，活像一座為高管虛榮而立的紀念碑。

items.defEn: to ease symptoms or severity without curing the underlying cause
items.usage: 醫學與修辭皆常用：治標不治本；也可指為過錯找藉口開脫。
items.exampleEn: Cash transfers may palliate poverty in the short run without altering its structural causes.
items.exampleZh: 現金補助或許能在短期緩和貧窮，卻不改變其結構性成因。

items.defEn: unnaturally pale; lacking force or vitality
items.usage: 可指臉色，也可比喻論證、演出「蒼白無力」。
items.exampleEn: The defense offered only a pallid rebuttal to the prosecution's timeline.
items.exampleZh: 辯方對檢方時間線的反駁顯得蒼白無力。

items.defEn: so intense as to seem almost tangible
items.usage: 感受、緊張或不公「濃到幾乎摸得到」。
items.exampleEn: Tension in the courtroom was palpable as the jury returned.
items.exampleZh: 陪審團返回時，法庭裡的緊張幾乎濃到可以觸摸。

items.defEn: ridiculously small or worthless in amount or quality
items.defZh: 微不足道的；少得可憐的
items.usage: 帶輕蔑：金額、努力或證據少得不像話。
items.exampleEn: The settlement offered a paltry sum compared with the documented losses.
items.exampleZh: 與有紀錄的損失相比，和解金少得可憐。

items.defEn: a remedy claimed to cure all difficulties
items.usage: GRE 幾乎都帶懷疑：世上少有真正的 panacea。
items.exampleEn: No single tax cut is a panacea for regional unemployment.
items.exampleZh: 沒有任何單一減稅措施能成為區域失業的萬靈丹。

items.defEn: flamboyant confidence and stylish flair
items.usage: 正面居多，指做事帶風格與魄力。
items.exampleEn: The conductor shaped the finale with unmistakable panache.
items.exampleZh: 指揮以十足的神采塑造了終樂章。

items.defEn: widespread over a whole country or the world, especially of disease
items.usage: 範圍大於 epidemic；也可比喻恐慌或錯誤資訊的全面蔓延。
items.exampleEn: A pandemic of misinformation complicated the public-health response.
items.exampleZh: 錯誤資訊的大流行使公衛應對更加複雜。

items.defEn: to cater to low or unworthy tastes or desires
items.usage: 強烈負面：為討好而放棄原則。
items.exampleEn: The campaign refused to pander to conspiracy theories merely to win applause.
items.exampleZh: 該競選活動拒絕只為博取掌聲而去迎合陰謀論。

items.defEn: a formal speech or piece of writing in high praise
items.usage: 正式、常近乎過度的讚美；可能真誠，也可能阿諛。
items.exampleEn: The retirement dinner turned into a panegyric that embarrassed even the honoree.
items.exampleZh: 退休晚宴變成一篇連當事人聽了都尷尬的頌辭。

items.defEn: an accepted model or pattern that organizes thinking in a field
items.usage: 學術高頻詞：paradigm shift 指基本模型的轉換。
items.exampleEn: The study offered a new paradigm for explaining urban heat islands.
items.exampleZh: 這項研究為解釋都市熱島提出了新的範式。

items.defEn: a statement or situation that seems contradictory yet may be true
items.usage: 重點是「表面矛盾，內裡可能成立」。
items.exampleEn: It is a paradox that greater connectivity can leave people feeling more isolated.
items.exampleZh: 連結愈多，人卻可能愈感到孤立，這正是一種悖論。

items.defEn: a perfect example of a particular quality
items.usage: paragon of virtue / efficiency 指某特質的完美代表。
items.exampleEn: The clinic became a paragon of transparent record-keeping in the region.
items.exampleZh: 這家診所成為該地區透明紀錄管理的典範。

items.defEn: of the highest importance; supreme
items.usage: of paramount importance 是固定搭配。
items.exampleEn: Patient safety remains paramount even when research deadlines loom.
items.exampleZh: 即使研究期限逼近，病人安全仍是至高無上的。

items.defEn: a person or group despised and rejected by others
items.usage: 可指個人，也可指在國際上被孤立的國家。
items.exampleEn: After the doping scandal, the sprinter became a pariah on the circuit.
items.exampleZh: 禁藥醜聞之後，該短跑選手在賽場上成了被排斥的人。

items.defEn: a humorous or satirical imitation of a style or work
items.usage: 透過誇張模仿來嘲諷；可作名詞或動詞。
items.exampleEn: The sketch was a sharp parody of academic jargon at its most inflated.
items.exampleZh: 這段短劇尖銳地戲仿了膨脹到極點的學術行話。

items.defEn: narrow in outlook; confined to a local or limited sphere
items.defZh: 眼光狹隘的；教區式的、只顧當地的
items.usage: GRE 多考比喻義「心胸／視野狹窄」，不只是教區的。
items.exampleEn: A parochial curriculum that ignores global history will ill prepare students.
items.exampleZh: 忽略全球史、眼光狹隘的課程，無法好好培養學生。

items.defEn: excessively frugal; unwilling to spend or give
items.usage: 統計上也可指模型「精簡」；GRE 詞彙多偏「小氣」。
items.exampleEn: The grant was too parsimonious to support a year of fieldwork.
items.exampleZh: 這筆補助吝嗇到無法支撐一年的田野工作。

items.defEn: strongly devoted to a party, cause, or side, often at the expense of fairness
items.usage: 可作形容詞或名詞；GRE 常暗示失去中立。
items.exampleEn: A partisan reading of the evidence ignored every finding that cut the other way.
items.exampleZh: 對證據的黨派式解讀，忽略了所有不利於己方的發現。

items.defEn: a work stitched together from varied styles or borrowed fragments
items.usage: 可中性指風格拼貼，也可暗示缺乏原創、東拼西湊。
items.exampleEn: The score was an elegant pastiche of baroque dance forms rather than a mere copy.
items.exampleZh: 這份樂譜是對巴洛克舞曲形式的雅緻混成，而非單純抄襲。

items.defEn: caused by or related to disease; extreme to an abnormal degree
items.defZh: 病理的；病態到不正常程度的
items.usage: GRE 常考比喻義：pathological liar 指病態說謊者，程度遠超尋常。
items.exampleEn: The inquiry found a pathological disregard for safety protocols in the plant.
items.exampleZh: 調查發現工廠對安全規程有病態程度的漠視。

items.defEn: an insufficiency or scarcity of something
items.usage: 正式書面語，常接 of evidence / data / resources。
items.exampleEn: A paucity of longitudinal data made the causal claim difficult to defend.
items.exampleZh: 縱貫資料不足，使該因果主張難以站住腳。

items.defEn: a minor fault or small offense
items.defZh: 小過失；無傷大雅的過錯
items.usage: 語氣輕：不是重罪，常用來對比真正的醜聞。
